name: prompt-improver
description: Attaches a short reading rubric beside each typed prompt so Claude resolves vague asks against the conversation before acting.

minWords.title: Minimum words
minWords.description: Prompts with fewer words than this are left alone (acknowledgements like "ok", "y").

maxWords.title: Maximum words
maxWords.description: Prompts with more words than this are left alone (they are already explicit).
